# Renderer budgets: maximum nanoseconds per frame for render_perf's
# production scenes (docs/benchmarks.md "Renderer runs"), enforced by
# .github/workflows/gpu-perf.yml on the self-hosted RTX 3060 Ti runner.
# Generated by scripts/render_budgets.py from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-01-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json:
# GPU entries are the recorded mean plus the 5 % allowance of CLAUDE.md
# §10.7 (50 µs floor below 0.2 ms); CPU entries are a flat 50 µs, which
# per-object work on the main thread would break.
# (interior_*: added 2026-11-02 from a run of those scenes alone (ADR-0074))
# reference_scenes-2026-11-02-interior-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# (interior_*: again 2026-11-02 (ADR-0075), from a run of those scenes alone)
# (bistro_*.gpu.ao and city_*.gpu.ao alone: again 2026-11-03, with the contact shadows' march
# (ADR-0076), the mean of two rounds a scene from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-03-contact-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round)
# (reflections (ADR-0077), 2026-11-03: the entries they took over their budgets or moved by 1.5 %
# or more to within 3 % of them against #150's build, and their own passes', the mean of two
# interleaved rounds a scene from reference_scenes-2026-11-03-reflections-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# and its second round)
# (local lights' shadows (ADR-0078), 2026-11-04: Bistro's entries they moved by 1.5 % or more
# to within 3 % of their budgets against #151's build, and the many lights' passes, Bistro's lamps
# being many lights now, the mean of two interleaved rounds a scene from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-04-local-shadows-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round)
# (the sun's map at its slope's level (ADR-0080), 2026-11-04: the entries it moved by 1.5 % or
# more to within 3 % of their budgets against the quality tiers' build, the mean of two
# interleaved rounds a scene from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-04-vsm-slope-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round)
# (city_*: every entry again 2026-11-06, the city cooked with voxels, its voxel meshes'
# normals and its cells' proxies (ADR-0068's amendment), the mean of two interleaved rounds

# round)
